scope: End-to-end confirmation of the Douyin QR sign-in on the chrome-devtools-mcp Chrome profile: the user scanned the app-rendered QR, completed second verification on the phone, and the browser reached a signed-in state. Only cookie NAMES and structural facts are recorded. No cookie value, session id, token, ticket, mobile number or account detail is kept.

endToEndResult.sequence: fresh QR issued by get_qrcode -> user scan -> check_qrconnect returned error_code 2046 -> short code sent and submitted -> validate_code returned a ticket -> retry poll -> signed in
pageSignalsAfterSuccess: the 登录后免费畅享 login wall disappeared
the login panel disappeared and the page navigated, which wiped the in-page recorder
a GET to /aweme/v1/web/user/profile/self/ returned 200, an endpoint that only answers for a signed-in session
endToEndResult.recorderNote: The in-page recorders were cleared by the post-login navigation, so the send_code / validate_code / confirmed frames of this particular run were not retained. Their contract was already captured earlier in the session and is unchanged.

credentialCookieNames.why: The sign-in completion check in apps/tauri/src-tauri/src/login.rs keys on sessionid | sessionid_ss, and until this run that pair had no capture backing at all: no fixture recorded it, and searches over the page's own scripts found nothing.
credentialCookieNames.method: Read the Cookie request header of a post-sign-in same-origin XHR (/aweme/v1/web/user/profile/self/) rather than document.cookie, because the credential cookies are HttpOnly.
notes: sessionid and sessionid_ss were present and carried the same value, as did sid_tt.
sessionid is HttpOnly and therefore invisible to document.cookie, which is why the earlier script searches could never have found it.
Anonymous session cookies that were already present before sign-in (passport_csrf_token, ttwid, odin_tt, UIFID, sdk_source_info, biz_trace_id, bd_ticket_guard_*) simply persist.
The sign-in also set login_time, a millisecond timestamp.
credentialCookieNames.verdict: The pair the desktop client checks is confirmed correct by live observation. The longer list above is recorded as context only; if the completion check ever needs widening, widen it from an observation like this one rather than by guessing.

outstanding: The confirmed response body of this run was lost to the post-login navigation, so the credential-field selection from that body still rests on the earlier capture.
Cross-SDK-version stability of the 0x8838 a_bogus constant remains unverifiable until Douyin ships a new build.
Only the mobile_sms_verify path has been exercised end to end; face_verify and mobile_up_sms_verify are contract-documented but not completed.
